proposals.title: Advisory vote on a shareholder proposal requesting the ability for shareholders to act by written consent
proposals.topic_summary: Requests the board permit shareholders entitled to cast the minimum votes needed to act to take action by written consent, including initiating any topic consistent with law.
proposals.evidence: The Board recommends that you vote AGAINST this proposal.

proposals.title: Advisory vote on a shareholder proposal requesting a report on plastic straws
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a report on business risks of continued plastic straw use and the company's efforts to develop and implement substitutes for plastic straws.
proposals.evidence: The Board recommends that you vote AGAINST this proposal.

proposals.title: Advisory vote on a shareholder proposal requesting a report on charitable contributions
proposals.topic_summary: Requests an annual report listing and analyzing charitable contributions, assessing congruency with stated values and brand/reputation risks from controversies.
proposals.evidence: The Board recommends that you vote AGAINST this proposal.
